### About me

Welcome and thanks for taking the time to check out my Applied Statistics and Visualization for Analytics final project. During this project, we investigate financial predictors of U.S. tax-exempt organizations. Below is some additional information about myself.

### Veronica Wood

![Veronica Wood](images_headshot.png){width=400}


My name is Veronica Wood. I earned a B.S. in Business Management from Virginia Commonwealth University in 2019, and I’m excited to learn more with a MS in Data Analytics Engineering program.

I have always been interested by the stories that data can tell and how those insights can drive meaningful improvement. My interest grew further during my role as a Budget Analyst for the Department of Defense, where I provide analysis across multiple financial portfolios.

I believe that pursuing the MS DAEN degree will provide me with a more well-rounded foundation in data analysis and position me for continued growth in the field.
